trial_type.Description: Which direction the tendon vibration stimulus targeted for this block. Only present for ses-vibration runs.

Levels.extension: tendon vibration targeting the extension direction
Levels.flexion: tendon vibration targeting the flexion direction

weight.Description: FSL-style 3-column EV weight for this condition block. Constant at 1 for every event in this dataset (no parametric modulation was used).
